title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe. Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets. Who you are: You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership. You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes. You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS. You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules. You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership. Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure. You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company. You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe. You will get a competitive salary. Our hiring team for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov. For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? description: SKINBRO ist eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Männerpflege-Marken Deutschlands. Feste Duschseifen, Deos und Parfums – plastikfrei, made in Germany, mit Düften, die Männer wirklich wollen. Über 90.000 Kunden, in den letzten Monaten jeden Monat fast verdoppelt. Wir sitzen in Hamburg, sind ein kleines, schnelles Team und wachsen ohne Konzernstrukturen. Unser Wachstum kommt aus Creatives. Aktuell produzieren wir rund 300 Ads im Monat mit einem Shooting pro Woche. Mit dir wollen wir auf drei Shootings pro Woche und über 1.000 Assets im Monat. Spoiler: Wir suchen keinen klassischen Videografen und keinen Creative Director. Wir suchen die Person, die Ideen in die Realität bringt. Die Creative Strategie – Konzepte, Skripte, Angles, Briefings – kommt fertig vom Gründer. Du bekommst am Anfang der Woche deine Shooting-Pläne und ziehst sie von A bis Z durch. Um dich herum: externe Video-Editoren, ein Grafikdesigner, ein eingespielter Prozess. Das ist eine ausführende Rolle, keine konzeptionelle. Wenn du lieber selbst die Strategie machen willst, ist das nicht die richtige Stelle. Wenn du Bock hast, in einer Creative-Maschine zu arbeiten, die bereits funktioniert, und sie mit uns zu verdreifachen – dann schon. Aufgaben Du führst 2–3 Shootings pro Woche eigenständig durch – ohne dass der Gründer am Set stehen muss. Du organisierst alles drumherum: Location, Darsteller, UGC-Creator, Zeitplan, Equipment, Verpflegung. Du sourcst regelmäßig neue Gesichter für Straßeninterviews, Schauspieler-Spots und UGC. Du bedienst die Kamera selbst und lieferst sauberes, verwertbares Rohmaterial nach Briefing. Du legst das Material strukturiert ab und übergibst es mit klarem Briefing an unsere Editoren. Du gibst den Editoren fundiertes Feedback und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst. Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Gründer, welche Creatives performt haben und welche nicht – und nimmst die Learnings mit ins nächste Shooting. Qualifikation Du kannst Shootings komplett selbstständig durchführen – Planung, Dreh, Ablage. Du kannst editieren (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci o. ä.) – gut genug, um Editoren präzise zu briefen, ihr Ergebnis zu bewerten und selbst Videos zu schneiden. Du hast Feingefühl am Set: Du empfängst Leute, machst sie locker, korrigierst taktvoll und sorgst dafür, dass alle gerne wiederkommen – auch bei Skripten, die etwas frecher sind. Du hast ein Gespür dafür, welche Person welche Aussage am glaubwürdigsten rüberbringt. Du arbeitest strukturiert nach Prozess und Checkliste und hast kein Problem damit, Content in hoher Frequenz zu produzieren, ohne dass die Qualität leidet. Du verstehst, was eine Performance-Ad von einem schönen Video unterscheidet – oder willst es schnell lernen. Du wohnst in Hamburg oder bist bereit, hierher zu ziehen. Benefits Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer-Team. Ads, die jeden Monat Millionen von Männern sehen – du siehst sofort, was dein Output bewirkt. raw.description:
Stellenbeschreibung:

Rügamer & Steiner ist die führende E-Mail Marketing Agentur hinter den erfolgreichsten E-Commerce Unternehmen in DE, AU & CH.

Über 150 Online Shops vertrauen uns bereits und erreichen mit uns die Herzen & Geldbeutel ihrer Kunden.

Da immer mehr Kunden ihr Vertrauen in Rügamer & Steiner setzen suchen wir Dich als Projektmanager E-Mail Marketing (m/w/d).

Du bist die zentrale operative Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie, Kunden und Umsetzung.

Als Projektmanager stellst du sicher, dass Kampagnen schnell, sauber und effizient umgesetzt werden – ohne Reibungsverluste.

Perfekt für dich, wenn du bereits Agenturerfahrung hast und weißt, wie wichtig Tempo, Struktur und saubere Prozesse sind.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Operative Umsetzung: Eigenständige Durchführung und technische Umsetzung von Marketing-Aufgaben und Kampagnen im Tagesgeschäft.
  • Daily Management & Ticketing: Strukturierte Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung aller eingehenden Aufgaben und Kundenanfragen.
  • Schnelle Kundenkommunikation: Sicherstellung extrem kurzer Reaktionszeiten. Kunden erhalten zeitnah (z. B. innerhalb von 30 bis 60 Minuten) eine erste Rückmeldung oder Zwischenantwort bei Anfragen.
  • Koordination: Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (z. B. Grafik und Copy). Du erstellst Briefings, definierst klare Deadlines und nutzt Projektmanagement-Tools (z. B. ClickUp) für reibungslose Abläufe.
  • Qualitätssicherung: Einleitung, Koordination und konsequente Nachverfolgung von Korrekturschleifen bis zur finalen Freigabe.
  • Problemlösung: Schnelles und pragmatisches Lösen von technischen oder organisatorischen Hürden im laufenden Betrieb.

Du trägst die Verantwortung für eine zuverlässige operative Umsetzung und die konsequente Einhaltung aller Deadlines. Gleichzeitig stellst du sicher, dass alle Prozesse technisch sauber, fehlerfrei und mit hoher Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit in der Kundenbetreuung umgesetzt werden.

Qualifikation

Das solltest du sein:

➜ Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Projektmanagement und Marketing

➜ Du arbeitest strukturiert, extrem organisiert und proaktiv

➜ Du bist zuverlässig und kannst viele parallele Aufgaben (Tickets) effizient managen

➜ Du denkst lösungsorientiert und bringst technisches Verständnis mit

➜ Du kommunizierst klar, präzise und schnell – sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.
  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen. Es gibt zudem ein monatliches Team-Lunch auf Kosten der Firma.
  • Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter: innen erhalten eine faire Vergütung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren. Daher benötigen wir weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte

...und noch viel mehr:

  • Modernes Büro in zentraler Lage in Düsseldorf Pempelfort mit Dachterasse und Anschluss an ÖPNV

  • Zusammenhalt in einem dynamischen und kollegialen Team

title: AI-First Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Join Sport Alliance and help build the data platform behind Magicline and Finion, serving thousands of gyms and 10M+ members. You'll tackle real engineering challenges, from high-volume data modeling and cost-efficient warehousing to freshness trade-offs and financial data that has to be exactly right. We're building an AI-first data team. We use cutting-edge LLMs and internal tools to work faster, and we expect you to use and improve them. The platform you build powers our AI and analytics, making clean, reliable, well-modeled data essential. Whether you're an experienced engineer ready to own the platform or a strong mid-level engineer eager to grow into the role, we'd love to hear from you. Your position in our team Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines on AWS — ETL/ELT and the infrastructure underneath (Aurora, Redshift, dbt, Spark/EMR, Airflow, CDC) — using AI tooling as a standard part of the workflow. Design and evolve the data models that power analytics, operational use cases, and AI/ML across thousands of studios. Help raise the bar on data reliability — embed governance, testing, and lineage so both people and AI systems can trust the numbers by default. Partner with product, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous business problems into robust data solutions. Evaluate and evolve new approaches with us — data mesh patterns, and emerging AI tooling — and help decide what genuinely earns a place in our stack. Grow into our financial and regulatory reporting workstream (Finion Capital), where correctness and auditability matter most. Your profile 3+ years in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing — and the appetite to take on more ownership than you've held so far. Strong SQL and Python for data work. Working with AI tools feels natural to you — and, just as important, the judgment to review and validate what they produce. You treat AI output as a draft to verify, not an answer to trust, especially where correctness is non-negotiable. A solid grasp of data architecture and modeling principles (dimensional modeling, slowly-changing dimensions, incremental patterns) — or the drive to deepen it fast. Hands-on experience with dbt on a cloud warehouse — this is where you'll live day to day. Working knowledge of relational and some exposure to non-relational Databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB). A track record of debugging tricky data issues and shipping durable fixes. Excellent written and verbal English. Nice to have AWS experience (Redshift, EMR, Glue, S3, IAM); experience with GCP or Azure is also welcome. Streaming/CDC technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium) or data mesh. Experience building data pipelines for ML or AI systems. Exposure to financial, payments, or regulated reporting data. German (helpful for some stakeholder work, but not required). Your salary We offer a salary range of EUR 72,000 – EUR 82,000 per year. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. Your benefits with us 30 Days Annual Leave with a 5-day workweek– enjoy extra paid time off to rest, recharge, and balance your work and personal life Flexible Work Model – 100% mobile work within Germany Fitness & Well-being (Choose 1 of 2): Stay active your way! Choose either our free Move Republic Program to earn points for rewards, OR join EGYM Wellpass for just a €20/month co-pay to access a massive network of gyms, pools, and studios (we cover the rest!) Access to Udemy – boost your skills with thousands of high-quality online courses Deutschland Ticket Subsidy – commute affordably – we cover part of your ticket cost Company Pension Scheme (bAV) – receive an above-average employer contribution in Germany or Austria Flexible Working Hours – adjust your schedule to fit your lifestyle Employee Discounts – access top deals in Germany and Austria via our benefits portal Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Germany. This is a highly technical sales role focused on helping engineering teams adopt infrastructure and developer-focused technology. You will own opportunities from initial engagement through close, working directly with technically sophisticated customers who expect credibility and speed. The role combines consultative selling, technical problem-solving, proof-of-concept management, and disciplined pipeline ownership. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers while becoming a trusted presence in customer communication channels and helping remove obstacles to purchase. Success requires the confidence to explain complex concepts simply, challenge assumptions, and be transparent when a solution is not the right fit. You will operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, urgency, and customer outcomes matter. This is an opportunity for either an experienced technical AE or a technically minded professional ready to take ownership of a sales quota. Accountabilities Own the sales process from qualified opportunity through successful close, with a strong focus on helping technical customers achieve their desired outcomes. Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, including actively participating in customer communication channels such as Slack. Manage and close inbound sales opportunities, moving prospects efficiently through the buying process. Lead and coordinate proof-of-concept initiatives in partnership with Solutions Engineers, ensuring technical and commercial objectives are clearly defined. Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase. Communicate honestly and transparently, including clearly explaining when a solution is not an appropriate fit. Maintain a systematic approach to pipeline management, ensuring opportunities, next steps, and follow-ups are consistently tracked. Navigate, improve, and contribute to internal sales and go-to-market systems and processes. Experiment with new approaches to prospect engagement, deal execution, and GTM workflows, using results and customer feedback to continuously improve. Move quickly and independently, identifying what needs to be done and taking action without requiring detailed direction. Requirements Proven experience as an Account Executive, particularly in a technical B2B, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-focused sales environment; alternatively, strong technical experience combined with readiness to take on a sales quota. Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to comfortably understand API documentation, technical product concepts, and engineering workflows. Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers. Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely. High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling. Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers. Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision. Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly. Experience with databases, search technologies, or infrastructure software is a plus. Familiarity with GTM automation tools such as Clay or n8n is advantageous. Comfort working with Python, JavaScript, Linux, or major cloud platforms is a plus. Willingness to prioritize correctness, customer evidence, initiative, and continuous improvement in day-to-day decision-making. Benefits Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to work from  Canada, the United States, or Europe . Significant autonomy and ownership over your work. Direct exposure to highly technical customers and engineering teams. Opportunity to work closely with Solutions Engineers and technical stakeholders. Chance to develop expertise across databases, search, infrastructure, and developer-focused technology. Fast-moving environment that encourages experimentation and learning from results. Opportunity to influence and improve internal go-to-market systems and processes. description: Für einen etablierten mittelständischen Anlagenbauer aus der Umwelt- und Verfahrenstechnik suchen wir aktuell eine:n Business Development Manager (all genders). Das Unternehmen entwickelt und realisiert anspruchsvolle Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasserbehandlung und begleitet seine Kunden über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette vom Konzept bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Der Fokus dieser Position liegt auf dem Auf- und Ausbau eines gesetzlich getriebenen, europaweit wachsenden Marktsegments. Aufgaben Sie treiben den Auf- und Ausbau eines wachsenden europäischen Marktsegments für die 4. Reinigungsstufe zur Spurenstoffelimination (EU und Schweiz) voran und verantworten dabei den gesamten Weg von der Priorisierung relevanter Länder und Märkte bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Sie sprechen Anlagenbetreiber, Kommunen sowie Planungs- und Ingenieurbüros gezielt an und begleiten diese entlang der Phasen öffentlicher Vergabeverfahren im Bereich der Wasseraufbereitung. Sie kalkulieren und erstellen technische Angebote, führen Verhandlungen und begleiten Ausschreibungsprozesse. Sie beraten Betreiber und Planungsbüros zu passgenauen Anlagenlösungen und arbeiten dabei partnerschaftlich zusammen. Sie bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb und Projektabwicklung und bringen Impulse zur technischen und organisatorischen Weiterentwicklung des Produktbereichs ein. Sie entwickeln länderspezifische Markterschließungsstrategien vor dem Hintergrund der aktuellen regulatorischen Entwicklungen. Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen auf Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, z.B. im Bereich Umwelttechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar. Sie bringen bereits Erfahrung aus dem Umfeld der Trink- bzw. Abwasserbehandlung mit, etwa aus einem Ingenieur- oder Planungsbüro, aus dem Anlagenbau oder aus der Zulieferindustrie. Sie kennen sich idealerweise mit öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren aus und haben idealerweise Erfahrung mit der VOB und den Leistungsphasen der HOAI. Sie verbinden vertriebliches Geschick mit echtem technischem Interesse und bringen Fachwissen aktiv in Beratung und Marktentwicklung ein. Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch für die Arbeit im europäischen Umfeld. Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke, Teamorientierung, unternehmerisches Denken und Eigeninitiative und möchten sich langfristig in einem kleinen, kulturbewussten Team verwurzeln. Sie bringen Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Europas mit (etwa 25%). Benefits 60.000 - 80.000 EUR p.a. Ein klar umrissenes, regulatorisch getriebenes Wachstumsfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive Großer Gestaltungsspielraum in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld Ein kleines, eng zusammenarbeitendes Team mit ausgeprägter Kultur- und Werteorientierung Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, den Produktbereich aktiv mitzugestalten Connectima ist eine spezialisierte Personalberatung, Headhunter und Executive-Search-Partner für Verfahrenstechnik und Filtration. Wir begleiten Fach- und Führungskräfte auf ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt, im DACH-Raum und international, entlang der gesamten Bandbreite dieser Branchen: von Membranfiltration, Prozessfiltration und Wasseraufbereitung über mechanische, chemische und thermische Verfahrenstechnik bis hin zu verfahrenstechnischen Komponenten wie Pumpen, Armaturen, Ventilen und Wärmetauschern. Unser Netzwerk umfasst mehr als 40.000 Fach- und Führungskräfte aus Chemie, Pharma, Maschinenbau und Umwelttechnik. Als reine Branchenspezialisten kennen wir die Unternehmen, Technologien und Entscheidungswege im Detail und beraten Sie persönlich, vertraulich und mit echtem technischem Verständnis. raw.title: (Senior) Recruiter (m/f/d)
raw.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic, fast-paced work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

We are looking for an experienced and driven (Senior) Recruiter (m/f/d) on a fixed term basis to join our Global BusinessTalent Acquisition team, supporting hiring in Germany HQ & Europe for corporate/business roles. In this role, you'll take ownership of end‑to‑end recruitment, partner with senior stakeholders, and help shape hiring strategies across a broad range of business functions.  

This role is based in Munich (hybrid model) and is offered as a 15-month fixed-term contract to cover maternity leave. 

About the Role 

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for business/corporate roles in Germany & Europe, covering multiple functions and seniority levels 
  • Act as a trusted sparring partner to hiring managers and senior stakeholders, shaping hiring strategies and defining effective sourcing and assessment approaches 
  • Proactively source and engage diverse talent pools using creative, data-driven methods across multiple channels 
  • Lead and conduct structured interviews independently, ensuring a consistent, high-quality selection process 
  • Use recruitment KPIs and ATS reporting (e.g., Greenhouse) to drive data-informed hiring decisions 
  • Deliver an excellent candidate experience while actively strengthening and representing the Flix employer brand throughout the hiring journey  
  • Contribute to cross-functional Talent Acquisition projects, focused on improving processes, scalability, and ways of working 

About You 

  • 4+ years of full-cycle in-house recruiting experience, ideally in a fast-paced, international environment 
  • Proven experience hiring business/corporate roles across multiple functions (e.g. finance, HR, marketing, sales, operations etc.) and seniority levels 
  • Strong stakeholder and offer management skills, with the ability to partner with senior leaders and build trusted relationships 
  • Resilient and agile, comfortable navigating ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities without losing focus or quality 
  • Strong active sourcing expertise with the ability to build and maintain sustainable talent pipelines 
  • Confident using data and recruitment metrics to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes 
  • Fluent in English, German is a strong plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer 

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

raw.title: Talent Lead
raw.description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Lead to own and build our hiring function from scratch. You’ll personally drive hiring across the company, build scalable recruiting processes, track hiring performance, and work closely with the Head of People and hiring managers across GTM, Ops, Research, and Product.

 

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Own and run the hiring process end-to-end (sourcing, screening, interviews, and closing)

  • Personally source and hire candidates across the company (this is a hands-on recruiting role)

  • Build our hiring processes and infrastructure from scratch, including interview loops, scorecards, pipelines, and candidate tracking

  • Work closely with hiring managers to define roles, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles

  • Drive hiring across a wide range of functions, including GTM, Ops, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Lead international hiring across the US, EU, UK, and other markets as we expand

  • Build and maintain hiring metrics and reporting, including pipeline conversion, time to hire, source performance, and offer acceptance

  • Use hiring data to identify bottlenecks and continuously improve the recruiting process

  • Build and maintain strong sourcing channels across different functions and geographies

  • Develop a strong candidate experience and represent White Circle throughout the hiring process

  • Help define and improve our approach to hiring, including how we assess candidates and make hiring decisions

  • Partner with leadership on long-term talent planning and hiring strategy

 

You’ll fit right in if you:

  • Have several years of experience running hiring at a startup, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth environment

  • Have personally hired a meaningful number of people and are comfortable owning the full recruiting process yourself

  • Have built hiring processes and recruiting operations from scratch

  • Have experience hiring across multiple functions, including GTM, Operations, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Have experience with international hiring across multiple countries and markets

  • Are comfortable working directly with leadership and senior hiring managers

  • Are highly data-driven and comfortable tracking and analysing recruiting metrics

  • Are an excellent sourcer and know how to find strong candidates beyond simply posting jobs

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Are comfortable operating independently in an environment where processes are still being built

  • Speak and write fluent English (C1+)

A big plus:

  • Experience hiring for AI, ML, and Research roles

  • Experience building a recruiting function as the first or one of the first talent hires

  • Experience hiring in the US, EU, and UK

  • Experience with employer branding and building a strong talent pipeline

  • Experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, research, or recruiting ops

 

Why White Circle

  • Meaningful equity package

  • Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  • All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  • Covered subscriptions for AI agents

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Mabella

 

How we hire

  1. Introductory call with Head of People (25 min)

  2. Practical Recruitment Exercise with Head of People (60 min)

  3. Final conversation with our CEO (45 min)

Please submit your application in English.

Was uns dabei antreibt? Teamspirit, kurze Wege und die Verbindung aus Technologie, Marketing und neuen Ideen. Mit unserer KI CREW by interface medien begleiten wir Unternehmen außerdem von den ersten Schritten mit KI bis zur eigenen Lösung. Mit Masterclasses, Bootcamps, Consulting und Engineering bringen wir Wissen, Praxis und Technologie zusammen – damit KI wirklich Wirkung zeigt. Aufgaben Dein Job bei uns. Bei uns übernimmst Du Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unseres SEO- und GEO-Bereichs. Dabei verbindest Du fundiertes SEO-Wissen mit Generative Engine Optimization, AI Search, Automatisierung und agentenbasierten Workflows. Dein Ziel ist nicht, möglichst viele SEO-Aufgaben manuell abzuarbeiten. Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und entwickelst intelligente Systeme, mit denen wir schneller analysieren, Potenziale erkennen, Maßnahmen ableiten und deren Wirkung messen können. Gleichzeitig sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen sowohl in klassischen Suchmaschinen als auch in KI-basierten Such- und Antwortsystemen bestmöglich sichtbar sind. Du konzipierst KI-gestützte SEO- und GEO-Workflows und automatisierst wiederkehrende Analyse-, Monitoring- und Rechercheprozesse mit Agenten und geeigneten Tools. Du testest neue Modelle, Tools und Ansätze und überführst sinnvolle Lösungen in unsere Arbeitsprozesse. Du arbeitest eng mit Entwickler:innen, Projektteams und Kund:innen zusammen und stellst dabei die Qualität unserer Ergebnisse sicher. Qualifikation Was Du mitbringst. Define acceptance criteria, build and run system-level test setups, automate recurring integration and regression tests with scripts and test tooling, and support field testing. Translate integration findings into design improvements for vehicle and payload interfaces, and feed validated test workflows into our CI and test infrastructure together with the HW integration and SW Factory teams. Work directly with payload suppliers: clarify requirements, review technical documentation, align interface specifications, and drive issue resolution. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation Create clear interface control documents, integration guides, test reports, lessons learned, and reusable standards for future payload integrations. Actively support build-ups, rework, payload installation, and vehicle-level commissioning in the workshop during prototype and customer-specific integration phases. What you bring to the team: Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, vehicle systems, or a comparable technical field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in field robotics, vehicle, or mechatronic system integration; you have brought complex E/E systems to life on real vehicles or machines. Strong E/E integration expertise: power distribution, signal interfaces, connectors, wiring harnesses, grounding, shielding, diagnostics, and vehicle-level troubleshooting. Solid mechanical integration understanding: mounting concepts, packaging, tolerances, vibration, environmental robustness, accessibility, and serviceability. Practical software skills for integration work: Linux, scripting (e.g. Python or Bash), software provisioning and configuration of embedded devices, and issue tracking tools. Experience defining and running validation setups from bench and rig level up to vehicle-level testing, with a quality-first mindset and the discipline to design reliable, repeatable test setups. Strong integration mindset: systematic in debugging, structured in documentation, and able to turn unclear payload requirements into practical engineering solutions. Hands-on mentality: comfortable working directly on vehicles, prototypes, harnesses, brackets, and payload installations in the workshop. Strong communication skills across engineering teams, suppliers, procurement, and program stakeholders. Fluent in German and English. High ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment. Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. Teamgeist und Impact-Kultur : Bei uns zählt Deine Stimme! Wir leben flache Hierarchien und eine Kultur des "Du" vom ersten Tag an. Das bedeutet: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit allen Ebenen und ein Team, das Dich aktiv unterstützt. Deine Ideen sind hier nicht nur willkommen, sondern werden gehört. Freiraum für Deine Ideen : Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst Deine Ideen aktiv einbringen. Wir fördern Deine Entwicklung – mit echtem Vertrauen in Deine Fähigkeiten. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information, please visit<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><a class="ms-outlook-linkify" href="http://www.vml.com/" data-outlook-id="fbec6e7f-765e-41de-af7b-a3ef743f9886"><u>www.vml.com</u></a><u>&nbsp;</u>and follow along on <a href="https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__urldefense.com_v3_-5F-5Fhttps-3A_www.linkedin.com_company_vml_-5F-5F-3B-21-21JboVxjCXSME-21OhlpCfbkl1UcWPwns1-2DGtvHOzFh0QwHV49fsPgGw-2DVCCU1bCg8aQFI9vN-2Dy-2DVwaQcITH2j2XKzGKBIFRLYf2AUWVYY1dFGK6-24&amp;d=DwMFaQ&amp;c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&amp;r=zouFnm4jZMgDFaYF1uVcRY3rbgHWPca_luUrBUkT6Yc&amp;m=QzcCgXCAOjzj5hiU48_CKOdHRSJ4_YpuqfviT9yjlzH5VrkzySTZ-WaQXlYAnj4W&amp;s=jJ7q5V70u9oUx7ONPm5jC3IK8y6vxDilX6BGTlqlWlA&amp;e=" data-outlook-id="b89e4621-22a7-4a88-a5da-c6ecc3a722be"><u>LinkedIn</u></a>&nbsp;#WeAreVML.</p></div><p><strong>Senior Strategist&nbsp;</strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Company:</strong> VML<br><strong>Working Model:</strong> Hybrid working<br><strong>Location:</strong> Sea Containers office, London, SE1</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&amp;R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our three core practices: Brand Experience, Customer Experience and Commerce. Within these practices, we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As a <strong>Senior Strategist</strong>, you'll be an important strategic voice within the team, working closely with Client Services, Creative, Data, Media and other specialist disciplines to turn business and customer challenges into clear, effective solutions.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You'll work on one of our major Pan-European automotive accounts, helping develop strategy across the customer journey — from brand consideration and lead generation through to lifecycle CRM, digital experiences and retail activations.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You'll be involved from brief through to delivery, using customer understanding, data, research and cultural insight to develop strong strategic thinking and give creative teams a clear direction. You'll also help ensure the work remains connected to the client's wider commercial objectives.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">This is a hands-on role, with the opportunity to take ownership of projects and workstreams while working closely with senior members of the strategy team. You'll have regular exposure to clients and will be expected to build trusted relationships, present your thinking confidently and contribute to conversations with stakeholders at different levels.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">There will also be opportunities to contribute to wider strategic projects, proactive thinking and new business, giving you the chance to bring your perspective to different challenges and develop your experience across the agency.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Develop strategic thinking across projects and workstreams, from understanding the brief through to creative development, client sell-in and measuring effectiveness.</li> <li>Turn business, customer, cultural and behavioural information into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.</li> <li>Develop compelling strategic and creative briefs that give creative teams a clear direction and space to do their best work across CRM, digital, social, search and dealership assets.</li> <li>Support end-to-end CRM communications across Passenger and Commercial Vehicles, including automated and triggered reminders, such as maintenance, MOT and servicing, seasonal promotional campaigns and ad-hoc owner messaging.</li> <li>Develop consideration and conversion activations for individual vehicle nameplates across UK and European markets, ensuring communications ladder seamlessly into wider global brand positioning.</li> <li>Contribute to the development of digital servicing journeys, helping increase consideration for official servicing through effective content and customer experience.</li> <li>Apply an understanding of modern search behaviour, including Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and LLM-ready content, to relevant communications and digital experiences.</li> <li>Work closely with Client Services, Creative, Data and Media partners to develop connected and effective solutions.</li> <li>Build strong working relationships with clients and become a trusted and credible strategic partner.</li> <li>Present strategic thinking and recommendations clearly and confidently to clients and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Use data, research and customer understanding to inform recommendations and strengthen the work.</li> <li>Challenge briefs and thinking constructively when there is an opportunity to make the work better.</li> <li>Contribute to pitches, proactive strategic projects, quarterly thought leadership and opportunities to grow existing and new client relationships.</li> <li>Support more junior members of the strategy team, sharing knowledge and helping raise the quality of strategic output.</li> <li>Bring curiosity and new thinking into the team, keeping up with changes in culture, technology, customer behaviour and the wider industry.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li><strong>Strategically strong:</strong> You can get to the heart of a problem, identify what really matters and turn it into a clear point of view.</li> <li><strong>Commercially minded:</strong> You understand how strategic thinking connects to client business objectives, customer acquisition, lead generation and long-term retention.</li> <li><strong>Confident but collaborative:</strong> You're comfortable presenting your thinking and contributing to senior conversations, while being open to challenge and different perspectives.</li> <li><strong>A strong communicator:</strong> You can make complex thinking feel simple, whether you're presenting to a client or briefing a creative team.</li> <li><strong>Customer curious:</strong> You genuinely want to understand what makes people tick and how behaviours, needs and motivations can influence the work.</li> <li><strong>Low ego:</strong> You care more about getting to the right answer than getting credit for having it. You enjoy working with different people and bringing the best out of those around you.</li> <li><strong>Adaptable:</strong> You can move comfortably between different types of briefs, from brand and communications strategy to CRM journeys, digital experiences and retail activation.</li> <li><strong>Culturally and technologically curious:</strong> You're interested in what's happening in the world and know how to turn those observations into useful strategic thinking. You're also interested in emerging technology, AI, LLMs and evolving search behaviours.</li> <li><strong>A team player:</strong> You enjoy working alongside Client Services, Creative and specialist teams and understand that the best work rarely comes from one person working alone.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Need</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Proven experience working as a Strategist or Senior Strategist within an agency environment. Automotive, mobility or Pan-European client experience would be a strong advantage.</li> <li>Experience developing strategic thinking from brief through to creative development and delivery.</li> <li>Strong understanding of customer behaviour, customer journeys and how different communications and experiences work together.</li> <li>Experience across some combination of brand, communications, CRM/lifecycle marketing, digital, social, search or customer experience.</li> <li>Confidence presenting strategic thinking and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>The ability to interpret data and research and turn it into meaningful insight.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and compelling.</li> <li>Experience working collaboratively with Creative, Client Services, Data, Media or other specialist teams.</li> <li>Experience contributing to pitches and/or proactive strategic projects would be beneficial.</li> <li>Experience supporting or mentoring more junior team members would be advantageous.</li> <li>An understanding of modern search trends, AI, LLMs and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) would be beneficial.</li> </ul> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Strategic thinking that is clear, compelling and rooted in genuine customer and business insight.</li> <li>Work that gives creative teams a strong strategic foundation and a clear opportunity to respond to.</li> <li>Clients who value your thinking and see you as a trusted strategic partner.</li> <li>Strong collaboration across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist teams.</li> <li>Strategic recommendations that contribute to meaningful client and business outcomes.</li> <li>The ability to take ownership of projects and move them forward with confidence.</li> <li>A positive contribution to the development and quality of the wider strategy team.</li> <li>Bringing clarity, curiosity and momentum to complex challenges.</li> </ul> <h2>What's in It for You?</h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>The opportunity to work on high-profile clients and environment where different perspectives are encouraged.</li> <li>The opportunity to work across a broad range of strategic challenges and develop your experience.</li> <li>A culture that values good thinking, curiosity, collaboration and people who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo.</li> <li>Strong learning, development and career progression opportunities.</li> <li>A competitive package, hybrid working and access to the full suite of company and group benefits.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the   • Support and adapt the execution of new processes with a focus on pace and customer experience

  • Provide proactive support and guidance to the sales team and our merchants to complete the onboarding process.

  • Respond to inbound requests from the Sales team regarding onboarding or reviewing existing clients’ profiles.

Example projects

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

What you'll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Own the Agent Development Life Cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you'll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase. Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers. Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely. High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling. Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers. Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision. Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification. Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away. Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL NEED Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work. Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels. Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability. [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context. TEHCNICAL SKILLSET Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy. Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility. GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short. Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation. Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it. [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES Languages: Python, SQL Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery Visualisation & BI: Looker Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API INTERVIEW PROCESS Step 1: People Team Screening Call (30 min) Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min) Step 3: Technical Task: covering both Modelling & Production with Presentation (60 min + Task) Step 4: Values Interview (45 min) WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly.

  • Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. Ideally you’ll have

  • Commercial Mindset: You think about business impact first. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work.

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels.

  • Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability.

  • [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context.

TEHCNICAL SKILLSET

  • Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy.

  • Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility.

  • GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short.

  • Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation.

  • Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it.

  • [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery

  • Visualisation & BI: Looker

  • Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub

  • Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow

  • LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API

INTERVIEW PROCESS

raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Account Management team led by Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global. The team consists of 5 Account Managers, each managing a portfolio of enterprise clients across different EMEA markets. Together, you'll be driving growth and retention for Mirakl's most strategic clients across the region, while regularly exchanging best practices and deal learnings with your counterparts in the AMER account management team.
"As a Senior Account Manager, you will be part of an international team of fun colleagues based in London, Boston, Bordeaux, and Paris. We connect through weekly syncs to share best practices and team wins, regular meet-ups for team-building activities, quarterly business reviews to align everyone on objectives, and a global yearly Sales Kick-off." — Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global
 

2. Your Impact

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise platform accounts, identifying and executing upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Marketplace, Drop Ship, and Catalog Manager products, managing complex sales cycles end-to-end with support from regional and specialist teams
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers at strategic accounts, serving as their go-to partner for marketplace strategy and growth
  • Develop and execute account plans that align client business objectives with Mirakl's roadmap, unlocking expansion opportunities across multiple markets and business units
  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams to deliver a seamless, high-value experience throughout the client lifecycle
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and the competitive landscape to proactively address client challenges and position Mirakl as the definitive platform of choice
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 8+ years in account management, sales roles managing global or strategic accounts in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell motions with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise clients
  • Experience working in an international context, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances across EMEA markets
Skills:
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to design and execute long-term account plans that create mutual value
  • Strong business acumen to understand complex client business models and connect them to Mirakl's solutions
  • Outstanding communication skills for engaging and influencing senior stakeholders across multi-stakeholder, international environments
  • Financial and analytical rigour to interpret complex contracts and assess revenue implications with confidence
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the drive to proactively build pipeline and unlock new growth opportunities
 

4. Tools Used

  • Salesforce
  • Mirakl internal tools
 

5. Languages

  • English: Fluent — C2 level required
  • French: Fluent — C2 level required

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application, this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition — 30 minutes to explore your background, motivations, and answer any questions about Mirakl
  2. Interview with Stanislas (VP Account Management Global) — Deep dive into your account management approach, commercial track record, and motivation
  3. Values-based interviews — Conversations with colleagues from across the business to assess alignment with Mirakl's core values
  4. Sales pitch exercise — A strategic presentation to demonstrate your commercial thinking and approach to enterprise account management

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Sales Account Executive - Enterprise, UKI (m/f/d)
description: What is Jedox? Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making. Trusted by more than 2,500 customers worldwide, Jedox enables business planning, budgeting and forecasting for finance, sales, and broader enterprise departments with leading-edge technology to outperform digital transformation and provide tangible customer value. At the heart of the platform is JedoxAI - a multi-agent intelligence engine delivering explainable, AI-powered forecasting, natural-language insights and AIssisted™ planning - putting Jedox at the forefront of the shift to AI-driven performance management. Your Responsibilities As a Sales Account Executive (m/f/d) within the Jedox team, you will play a key part in helping enterprise customers to transform their planning, forecasting and performance management processes. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions. In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success. We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here. You will own your number, your territory and your pipeline - creating opportunity rather than waiting for it, with a team around you that celebrates the wins together. Own the end-to-end sales cycle: Generate revenue by adopting a value-selling approach throughout the process, from initial engagement to closing enterprise-level deals - with full personal accountability for every outcome in your territory. Create and own high-quality pipeline: Build and maintain healthy pipeline coverage against your quota through proactive, self-generated prospecting - not just inbound - with disciplined weekly pipeline management in our CRM as the single source of truth. Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features. Inspire digital transformation: Engage prospects by presenting a clear and compelling vision of digitisation and integrated business planning. Develop strategic sales plans: Identify, prospect and execute targeted sales plays and activities to win enterprise customers, including structured account planning, rigorous qualification (e.g. MEDDPICC) and multi-threading across finance, IT and operations stakeholders. Cross-functional collaboration: Acquire new customers by working closely with the pre-sales, channel management, marketing and business development teams - bringing colleagues and partners in early, and lifting each other up as one team with one number. Drive market-facing activity: Contribute to workshops, webinars and events alongside marketing and partners to create demand and build visible expertise in your market. Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners. Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities. Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success. Your Profile Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function. Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions. Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals. Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts. A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together. Resilience and positivity: you're the kind of person who stays positive, keeps going and enjoys the journey as much as the win. A love of being active in the market: you genuinely enjoy talking to customers and partners - on calls, in meetings and at events - and you know that's where great pipeline comes from. Strong collaboration skills with a clear focus on customer success and innovation. Confident, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar) in your day-to-day selling - for example researching accounts, building presentations and business cases, sharpening messaging and working smarter across the sales cycle. Native or fluent English skills; an established network and knowledge of the UK & Ireland enterprise market are a real advantage. Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes. In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people. If you would like to learn more about the process, please visit the website of our partner Hi People . description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact.
