Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of the role</strong></h4> <p>We are seeking a Principal Security Researcher to join our<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/"> </a>Application Security Team to conduct cutting-edge security research on GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps capabilities. As GitLab transforms software development through intelligent collaboration between developers and specialized AI agents, we need security researchers who can proactively identify and validate vulnerabilities before they impact our platform or customers.</p> <p>In this role, you'll be at the forefront of security research, working with our GitLab DevSecOps platform, Duo Agent Platform, GitLab Duo Chat, and AI workflows that represent the future of human/AI collaborative development. You'll develop novel testing methodologies (including for AI agent security), conduct hands-on penetration testing, and translate emerging threats into actionable security improvements. Your research will directly influence how we build and secure the next generation of AI-powered DevSecOps tools, ensuring GitLab remains the most secure software factory platform on the market.</p> <p>This position offers the unique opportunity to shape security and AI security practices in one of the world's largest DevSecOps platforms, working with engineering teams who are pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI-assisted software development. You'll have access to cutting-edge AI systems and the freedom to explore creative attack scenarios while contributing to the security of millions of developers worldwide.</p> <p>This role reports to the Senior Manager of Application Security.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do&nbsp;</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Conduct and lead security research projects across multiple functional areas.</li> <li>Identify novel, systemic, and chained vulnerabilities in GitLab, where individual weaknesses combine for outsized impact.</li> <li>Validate security vulnerabilities through hands-on testing, developing proof-of-concept exploits that demonstrate real-world attack scenarios.</li> <li>Assess emerging industry vulnerability classes against the GitLab codebase, and drive remediation of the class rather than the instance.</li> <li>Lead security research into GitLab's AI and agentic surfaces, and define the security requirements that engineering teams build against.</li> <li>Build and direct the tooling and automation that scales security research, including agent-assisted vulnerability discovery across our codebase.</li> <li>Research the security posture of open source tools and dependencies integrated with GitLab, report findings to their maintainers, and track mitigation following our <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/security/disclosure/">responsible disclosure guidelines</a>.</li> <li>Solve technical problems of the highest scope, complexity, and ambiguity.</li> <li>Help shape the team and sub-department roadmap.</li> <li>Lead the integration of security research results into the engineering and business functions that need to act on them.</li> <li>Teach, mentor, and advise other domain experts and individual contributors across several teams.</li> <li>Share knowledge and novel vulnerability types with the security community.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in security research, penetration testing, or offensive security roles</li> <li>Strong ability in discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in large codebase and complex systems</li> <li>Proficiency in two or more of Ruby, Go, Python, TypeScript, or Rust.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to read and analyze code across multiple languages and codebases</li> <li>Strong knowledge of AI frameworks</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI attack vectors including prompt injection, agent manipulation, and workflow exploitation</li> <li>At ease in establishing and driving complex remediation initiatives involving cross-functional teams</li> <li>Excellent written communication skills with an ability to articulate complex topics in a clear and concise manner.</li> <li>Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear risk assessments and remediation recommendations</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with creative thinking about attack scenarios</li> <li><strong>Nice to Have: </strong>Published security research or conference presentations; background in software engineering with distributed systems expertise; experience with GitLab or similar DevSecOps platforms</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Security Researchers are a part of our<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/"> </a>Application Security team, who address complex security challenges facing GitLab and its customers to enable GitLab to be the most secure software factory platform on the market. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <h4><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career:</strong> If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></h4> <ul> <li>Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.</li> <li>Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.</li> <li>Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.</li> <li>Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.</li> <li>Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.</li> <li>Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.</li> <li>Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.</li> <li>Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.</li> <li>Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment&nbsp; — not a single product or team's slice of it.</li> <li>Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.</li> <li>Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.</li> <li>Strong AWS cloud services background.</li> <li>Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).</li> <li>Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.</li> <li>Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.</li> <li>Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.</li> <li>Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).</li> <li>Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.</li> <li>Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.</li> <li>Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.</li> <li>Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.</span></p></div><div class="title">Annual Base Salary</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£138,800</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£173,500 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a> is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.</p></div><div> <h2><strong>What’s the opportunity?</strong></h2> <p>Fin's websites, including&nbsp;<a href="https://fin.ai/">fin.ai</a>, are strategic growth levers for the company — powering storytelling, brand, experimentation, and product discovery. As our Staff Engineer, you will shape the technical direction and architectural evolution of our web platform and systems. You’ll act as the technical leader across our marketing and growth web surfaces. This is a cross-functional engineering leadership role, partnering with marketing, analytics, design, data science, and engineering teams — to ensure our web stack is modern, performant, measurable, and delightful to build on. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and will be accountable for setting the long-term technical strategy for the team and executing against it.</p> <h2><strong>What will I be doing?</strong></h2> <p>As a senior technical leader, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Own and evolve the architecture of Fin's web platform.</li> <li>Define the long-term technical strategy for the web team, focusing on scalability,&nbsp;performance, developer productivity, observability, and system reliability.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with marketing, design, analytics, and data science stakeholders to&nbsp;ensure the platform supports their goals with accuracy, performance, and agility.</li> <li>Lead and influence the design and implementation of MarTech systems for event&nbsp;tracking, attribution, funnel reporting, A/B testing infrastructure, and more.</li> <li>Partner with engineers across web, infrastructure, and data to create a high-quality,&nbsp;cohesive technical ecosystem.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate engineers across the team and organisation — providing guidance on architecture, data modeling, system design, and engineering best practices.</li> <li>Set the standard for technical excellence in reliability, maintainability, code quality, and&nbsp;operational readiness.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership and insight to Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and executive stakeholders - communicating risks, trade-offs, and opportunities clearly.</li> <li>Contribute hands-on to the codebase — leading by example and helping unblock and&nbsp;accelerate key projects.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What skills do I need?</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who brings deep technical expertise, cross-functional leadership,&nbsp;and strong domain knowledge in web systems. You should have:</p> <ul> <li>8+ years of software engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience in a high-scale growth-focused web environment.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or departments.</li> <li>Deep expertise in <strong>Next.js</strong> and the <strong>React</strong> ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience with<strong> headless CMS platforms </strong>such as Contentful or Sanity - including content modeling, migration, and multi-site architecture.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with <strong>infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)</strong>, cloud platforms (<strong>AWS, CloudFront, S3</strong>), and deployment platforms (Vercel).&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience designing or operating <strong>experimentation infrastructure </strong>- A/B testing frameworks, event instrumentation, attribution systems and tools like Eppo.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of <strong>web analytics and data instrumentation</strong> - experience with event tracking SDKs, Google Tag Manager, or similar.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfortable working in and supporting full-stack codebases - even if this role is not UI-heavy, a solid frontend architecture awareness is valued.</li> <li>Experience operating in continuous delivery environments with an emphasis on incremental, high-quality shipping.&nbsp;</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills and a history of collaborating with cross-functional teams (product, marketing, analytics, design, etc.)</li> <li>A mentorship mindset — proven ability to raise the bar for engineering excellence across a team or organization.</li> </ul> <div> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements.<br><br>Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at <span><a href="http://fin.ai/careers" target="_blank">fin.ai/careers</a></span>.</p> <p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. description: Your mission Greetings, fellow seeker of sustainable futures! We're thrilled to present a pivotal role that connects cutting-edge technology with the operational excellence of renewable energy assets across Europe, the Senior O&M Asset Manager. Curious what this quest entails? Let's dive right in: Hold senior accountability for the asset management of PV and ESS portfolios across Europe, ensuring compliance with LTSAs, SLAs, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Asset Managers, setting objectives, reviewing performance, and building capability. Act as the senior escalation point and primary customer interface for complex technical, contractual, warranty, and corrective service issues. Perform and oversee advanced contract analysis, identifying risks, obligations, and value optimization opportunities, and actively support LTSA negotiations. Provide senior technical oversight by reviewing and validating Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), interpreting SCADA data, and assessing equipment logs. Lead service partner performance management in collaboration with procurement and O&M teams, focusing on cost control, service quality, and contractual compliance. Drive a data-driven asset management approach, including availability and performance analysis, spare parts strategy, and lifecycle cost optimization. Ensure strong cross-functional coordination with Projects, Sales, Engineering, and HQ to support asset handover and continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute directly to the profitability and long-term value of the O&M business through cost optimization, risk management, and performance-driven decision-making. Champion continuous improvement in processes, reporting, asset performance, reliability, and team ways of working across the European asset management function. Your profile All right, all right, that was intriguing, wasn't it? Now, in order to fit in this role and be happy for a long time, your ideal background should look a lot like this: A degree in engineering, business, contracting, or a related technical field is essential. You possess a strong technical background in PV and Energy Storage (BESS) technologies. Extensive experience in O&M asset management, handling complex asset portfolios and long-term service agreements is required. Advanced expertise in contract analysis, including warranties, SLAs, penalties, liabilities, and risk allocation, is crucial. You have a proven ability to review and validate RCAs, and to analyze SCADA data and equipment logs at a senior decision-making level. Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, with the ability to set priorities, coach performance, and drive accountability is expected. raw.description:
Bookkeeper — Lab54

Location: London. All 3 days in office for the first three months. From month 4, 1 day per week remote once the agreed targets are being met.

Shape: Part-time, 3 days per week. Permanent or contract — both considered.

Salary: £30–34k FTE equivalent, pro-rata (£18–20.5k at 3 days). Contract equivalent £150–200 per day.

Reports to: Financial Controller (interim: Managing Director)

Start: As soon as available

About Lab54

Lab54 is a content-led events and production company: [Anywhere But A Club.]

We create high-impact experiences in unexpected locations, capture them, and turn them into content. Combined global audience of 425,000+. We work with brands, record labels and artists — around 100 events a year across brand activations, artist pop-ups, hard-ticket shows, house parties and festival takeovers.

The role

The Bookkeeper is Lab54's day-to-day finance function: reconciliation, purchase-order matching, receipt capture, invoicing, debtor chasing and payroll preparation.

The defining feature of the job is that every pound has to land against an event. Lab54's core financial object isn't the month — it's the project. Each event carries a code (YYMM-Owner-Event-City) that runs from HubSpot through Xero, Teamwork and the purchase-order flow. Coding transactions to that project is not admin; it's the thing that makes per-event profitability computable. It is the single most important part of this role.

This role prepares, never approves. All payment runs are approved by the Managing Director, with the CEO approving above an agreed threshold.

Responsibilities

Purchase orders and supplier ledger

  • Match supplier invoices to their purchase order in Xero. This is a manual link, and it is the control that stops us paying more than we agreed.
  • Enforce the PO rule at the front door: any commitment of £500 or more needs a PO, and an invoice arriving without a PO number goes back to the supplier rather than into the ledger.
  • Prepare payment runs for approval. Nothing leaves the business without a bill, a PO and a sign-off.
  • Reconcile supplier statements monthly against our purchase ledger — the check that catches duplicate invoices and payments before they're made.
  • Maintain the purchase ledger and keep the aged creditor position accurate.

Reconciliation and coding

  • Bank and card reconciliations kept current within 48 hours, including Revolut Business card spend against Xero tracking categories.
  • Every reconciled line matched to a real source document. A line that reconciles without a bill behind it is an exception to raise, not a box to tick.
  • Code every transaction to the correct project code and tracking category. Chase the team when a code is missing rather than guessing one.
  • Keep the suspense and uncoded accounts at nil by month-end.
  • Produce a weekly untagged-spend report, by spender, and drive it to zero.

Receipts and VAT recovery

  • Chase and capture missing receipts to a 98% target. This is a cash exercise, not a filing one — every missing VAT invoice is input VAT we can't reclaim.
  • Flag transactions carrying no VAT treatment where the supplier is UK VAT-registered.
  • Prepare the VAT return workings for the external accountancy firm, who own submission.

Sales invoicing and debtors

  • Raise client invoices within 48 hours of the billing trigger, coded to the project.
  • Own debtor chasing end to end — a consistent cycle, escalated when it stalls, so nobody else in the business is carrying it.
  • Match incoming receipts to the right invoice and contact. Money that arrives against the wrong customer looks identical to money that never arrived.
  • Keep sales invoice sequencing clean — anything voided or reissued carries a recorded reason.

Project close

  • When a project closes, produce its final position: budgeted cost against actual cost, budgeted revenue against invoiced revenue, and the resulting margin.
  • Issue that to the CEO and Operations Director as a matter of routine. It is not a report anyone should have to request.
  • Late costs land after an event has finished — that's the nature of the business. The job is to make sure they land against the right project and that the closing number reflects them.

Cash and reporting

  • Produce a weekly cash one-pager: bank position, overdue debtors with days outstanding, payment runs due, projected balance.
  • Keep the company's master P&L model current — updating actuals and committed costs as they change, so the forecast reflects where the business genuinely is.
  • The model is ours; you update the numbers within it. Structural or formula changes come to the CEO first.

Payroll preparation

  • Prepare payroll data and submit it to the external payroll provider ahead of deadline.
  • Post the payroll journal to Xero each month. Wages must not sit in a control account.
  • Confirm the payroll account is funded before each run. This role does not execute payroll.

Close, deadlines and records

  • Run the monthly close to a published working-day deadline: accruals prepared with supporting detail, journals posted, period locked.
  • Every accrual carries a schedule — supplier, event, date of work. No balance we can't explain.
  • Maintain the statutory deadline register (VAT, PAYE, corporation tax, Companies House) and flag each one in advance. No filing sits invisibly in someone else's workflow.
  • Keep records orderly and audit-ready for the external accountancy firm.

What the first 90 days actually look like

We are being straight about this because we want someone who finds it interesting rather than alarming.

Lab54 has grown faster than its finance function, and we've recently changed accountants. The ledger carries a real backlog: untagged transactions across two financial years, unposted payroll journals, a month-end close that has not been run to a cadence, and a purchase-order process that has only just gone live. There is a documented correction schedule and an external FD working through it.

The first 90 days is a clean-up, not a steady state.

Days 1–30. Learn the ledger and the project-code structure. Take over reconciliation, receipt capture and PO matching. Get the weekly untagged report running.

Days 31–60. Clear the untagged backlog. Take over sales invoicing, debtor chasing and received-payment matching. Payroll preparation and the monthly payroll journal move across.

Days 61–90. Run a full month close to deadline: suspense at nil, every accrual scheduled, supplier statements reconciled. Per-project cost data becomes reportable for the first time.

After that it becomes a genuinely well-defined job inside a documented control structure — and you'll have built it.

On being in the office. The first three months are fully office-based, and that's deliberate rather than a policy position. Clearing a backlog this size means asking people questions in real time — whose card that was, what the missing PO covers, which event a supplier belongs to. That's an hour of work in a room and a week of work over email. From month 4, one of the three days moves to remote, provided the measures below are being met.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Proven bookkeeping experience. Xero to a high standard is non-negotiable — tracking categories, purchase orders, bank rules, manual journals.
  • Purchase-order matching and supplier statement reconciliation as routine practice.
  • A project- or job-costing background — agency, events, production, construction, consultancy, anywhere the job rather than the month is the unit of profit. This is the part of the role we can't train quickly.
  • Strong reconciliation, coding and purchase-ledger discipline.
  • Experience preparing payroll data for an external provider and posting the payroll journal.
  • Comfortable working inside a defined control structure where you prepare and someone else approves.
  • Reliability over ambition. The value of this role is that nothing is ever late or missing.

Nice to have

  • Multi-currency invoicing and foreign supplier payments. We run events across Europe.
  • Dext, Revolut Business, or similar capture and expense tooling.
  • Experience cleaning up a ledger rather than only maintaining a tidy one.

How you'll work

  • Meticulous. Proactive on receipts, POs and debtors — chasing people is part of the job, not an escalation.
  • Willing to say when something doesn't look right. A number you can't explain is a question, not a rounding difference.
  • Discreet and trustworthy with company finances.

You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. The CEO Office The CEO Office works with senior leaders across Checkout.com on high-priority strategic and operational problems. The team turns important questions into clear decisions, coordinated execution and measurable business outcomes. The role This is a manager-level individual-contributor role for a hands-on operator. You will own defined, high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end—from framing problems and aligning stakeholders to implementing solutions and delivering measurable outcomes. Working closely with the Head of the CEO Office, you will combine structured problem-solving with hands-on execution. You will translate priorities into coordinated action, strengthen how teams operate and drive initiatives through to impact. This is neither a traditional PMO nor a presentation-led strategy role, and it is not an executive-level position. Success requires sound judgement, analytical rigour, clear communication, operational follow-through and the ability to influence effectively without formal authority. How You'll Make an Impact (Role overview) Support the CEO and Head of the CEO Office on critical cross-functional initiatives by helping coordinate day-to-day delivery, stakeholder collaboration and progress towards measurable outcomes. Help investigate complex, ambiguous problems by clarifying the problem, developing practical solutions and supporting the implementation of durable processes or systems. Support departments in scaling by contributing to organisation design, objectives and KPI setting, and the development of robust operating processes. Assist leadership in navigating ambiguity by surfacing insights, decisions and risks, coordinating follow-through and supporting alignment across teams, particularly where there is no natural owner. Projects may include organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines, strategic planning and goal setting, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, and supporting board and shareholder reporting. What We're Looking For (Background and core competencies) Relevant background and impact: Experience in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.Relevant backgrounds include consulting, high-growth technology, investing, investment banking, strategic finance or entrepreneurial operations. Payments or fintech exposure and international experience are advantages. Problem-solving and analytical rigour: Use first-principles thinking, data and judgement to structure ambiguous problems, identify key measures and move between strategic questions and operational detail. Advanced SQL or hands-on data analysis is a plus. Building and execution: Turn analysis into practical plans, KPIs, processes, tools or systems that create durable value. Experience building low-code/no-code or AI automations that others continue to use is a plus. Ownership and impact: Personally own cross-functional work and deliver measurable outcomes. Influence and collaboration: Build trust, navigate trade-offs and make progress across functions without formal authority, with a low-ego and collaborative approach. Learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset: Learn quickly, respond well to feedback, adapt to changing priorities and show evidence of creating, launching or materially improving something from scratch. Founding or entrepreneurial experience is valued but not required. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. raw.title: Senior Innovation Consultant
raw.description:
Job summary (Short promotional text)

PNO Innovation UK is looking for an experienced Senior Innovation Consultant / Senior Grant Writer to lead complex Horizon Europe proposals and advise innovative organisations on their funding strategies.

This is a genuinely senior role combining approximately 60% grant writing and 40% innovation consultancy. You will work independently with clients, technical experts and international consortium partners, transforming ambitious scientific and technological concepts into compelling, competitive proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Your mission is to help innovative organisations secure European funding and turn promising ideas into impactful collaborative projects. You will guide clients from initial opportunity assessment and project concept development through to the preparation and submission of high-quality Horizon Europe proposals.

As a trusted advisor, you will combine exceptional writing skills with strategic insight, technical curiosity and strong client leadership.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead complex Horizon Europe proposals from initial strategy and concept development through to final submission.
  • Write and review Excellence, Impact and Implementation sections, ensuring a clear, persuasive and evaluator-focused narrative.
  • Develop project structures, work packages, deliverables, milestones, budgets and implementation plans.
  • Coordinate international consortia, technical contributors and other stakeholders throughout the proposal process.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Advise clients on funding opportunities, programme positioning, call requirements and long-term funding strategies.
  • Translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, compelling and commercially relevant applications.
  • Manage senior client relationships, challenge assumptions and provide confident strategic recommendations.
  • Support business development while mentoring colleagues and reviewing and improving the quality of their work.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience in grant writing, innovation consultancy, European funding or a closely related field.
  • Extensive, hands-on experience with Horizon Europe and/or Horizon 2020 proposals.
  • A strong track record of independently leading competitive proposals from concept to submission.
  • Genuine consulting experience, including ownership of client relationships and complex assignments.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and technical concepts clearly.
  • Strong scientific, technical or innovation literacy and the curiosity to understand unfamiliar technologies quickly.
  • Ability to work credibly across sectors such as life sciences, health, agrifood, bio-based industries, energy, environment and industrial innovation.
  • A highly autonomous, commercially aware and collaborative approach, together with the right to work in the UK.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Join a specialist innovation consultancy with extensive experience in European research and innovation funding.
  • Work on ambitious international projects addressing major scientific, industrial and societal challenges.
  • Take genuine ownership of important clients and complex Horizon Europe assignments.


Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Collaborate with experienced consultants and innovation experts across PNO Innovation’s European network.
  • Contribute to the continued development of PNO Innovation UK and help shape how we support our clients.
  • Benefit from a competitive salary of £55,000–£65,000, with flexibility above the stated range for an exceptional candidate whose experience and seniority strongly align with the role.

title: Senior Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.</p> <p>Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to <strong>be curious, have courage, and commit fully</strong>.</p> <p>Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape how technology empowers neurodivergent individuals and people with physical, sensory and other disabilities.</p> <p>You'll work across Everway's portfolio of special education and assistive technology solutions for school and workplace environments, collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Research, Content and other cross-functional partners.</p> <p>A key focus of this role will be our IEP product portfolio, including Polaris, Embrace Education and Spedtrack. You'll work across interconnected products and experiences, helping create coherent, accessible and scalable solutions that support the needs of educators, administrators and students.</p> <p>This role offers the opportunity to think beyond individual features and products. You'll help shape shared experiences and interaction patterns across the portfolio, balancing consistency with the unique context and needs of individual products and users.</p> <p>You'll lead end-to-end design work, from understanding complex problems and synthesising research through ideation, prototyping, validation and delivery. You'll contribute to product strategy, design quality and our design system, while exploring practical applications of AI and emerging technologies.</p> <p>You'll also work closely with other designers, providing senior design partnership, sharing knowledge and helping raise design quality across the portfolio.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to have a significant influence on the future of Everway's IEP experiences and help create accessible, coherent and high-quality products that make a meaningful difference to the people who use them.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h4><strong>Main responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Content and Marketing to deliver product experiences that meet user and business needs.</li> <li>Own end-to-end design work within your scope, contributing design expertise to product decisions from early discovery through delivery and iteration.</li> <li>Help frame problems, identify opportunities and contribute design insight to product strategy and planning.</li> <li>Design across interconnected products, workflows and user journeys to create scalable and coherent experiences.</li> <li>Translate user insights, product analytics and business objectives into intuitive, accessible and scalable design solutions.</li> <li>Work closely with Engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable and effectively implemented.</li> <li>Contribute to and evolve Everway's design system, supporting consistency, scalability and accessibility across products.</li> <li>Explore and apply AI where it creates meaningful value, improving design workflows, accelerating prototyping and supporting new product experiences, while considering usability, accessibility, trust, transparency and user control.</li> <li>Create and present design concepts, prototypes and solutions with clear rationale linked to user, product and business objectives.</li> <li>Advocate for inclusive design and ensure work meets or exceeds relevant accessibility standards.</li> <li>Partner with researchers to integrate user insights into iterative design and validation cycles.</li> <li>Balance qualitative user insights with quantitative product analytics to inform design decisions and measure the success of shipped experiences.</li> <li>Facilitate workshops, design reviews and co-creation sessions with peers and stakeholders.</li> <li>Share knowledge and contribute to design practice, learning and innovation across the UX and Product organisation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Essential criteria</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Significant product design experience, including 3+ years operating at Senior Product Designer level, with a strong portfolio demonstrating how design decisions contributed to measurable user, product or business outcomes.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work with ambiguity, frame complex problems and influence product direction.</li> <li>Experience applying inclusive and universal design principles, reducing cognitive load, and designing to recognised accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2</li> <li>Experience designing across interconnected products, complex workflows or end-to-end user journeys while considering the wider product ecosystem.</li> <li>Hands-on experience contributing to and evolving design systems.</li> <li>Strong prototyping and interaction design skills, with the ability to use prototypes to explore, test and communicate ideas.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern design tools such as Figma.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-enhanced design workflows and an understanding of emerging human-AI interaction patterns, including trust, transparency, uncertainty and user control.</li> <li>Ability to communicate and influence design decisions clearly across a range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong collaboration with Product Management and Engineering, balancing user needs, business goals and technical constraints.</li> <li>Understanding of modern product development approaches such as Agile, Lean UX, continuous discovery and iterative delivery, with experience facilitating collaborative design activities.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable criteria</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience designing across Web, iOS and Android in a complex SaaS environment.</li> <li>Experience designing products for education, accessibility, assistive technology or other complex user needs.</li> <li>Experience designing or shipping AI-enabled product experiences.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted prototyping or design-to-development workflows.</li> <li>Experience working with product analytics and experimentation to evaluate product outcomes.</li> <li>Familiarity with designing for enterprise, education or multi-user environments with complex permissions, roles or workflows.</li> </ul> <p>Please submit your application by <strong>Friday 18th September 2026.</strong></p> <p>Please note: applications may close early due to high demand, so early submission is encouraged.</p> <p>#everway</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Join our team and enjoy a competitive salary with bonus opportunities, flexible work schedules, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. We offer flexible time off plans, career growth through development programs, and a collaborative, innovative culture where your ideas matter.&nbsp; Ready to make an impact? Apply today and be part of a company that invests in your success!</p> <p>We are committed to providing a Drug-Free Workplace for all employees.</p> <p>We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>You can view our Recruitment and Selection Policy <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yDxHyVbhh8MK9NnCYdnEAfVSO4rhPCovVbKK8ecxT4U/edit?usp=sharing">here.</a></p> <p>Please click the link for our <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1uAKvHVSRsqZ83CGhM3_3Dc6RPsXwlTdmwdUH7msHkVM/edit?usp=sharing">Privacy Notice</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team The Enterprise Business team at Airwallex helps ambitious businesses operate globally by providing the financial infrastructure they need to manage payments, money movement and related financial operations. The Account Management team works strategically to maximise the enterprise customer-Airwallex partnership by building trust, identifying and driving new revenue streams, and ensuring operational success.. You will work alongside , Leadership, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations,Legal, GTM Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance and Revenue Strategy & Operations. The team operates with a high level of ownership and collaboration, managing complex customer needs and contributing directly to enterprise growth. What you’ll do As an Account Manager on the Enterprise team, you will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise Airwallex value. You will build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, while identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets. You will combine strategic account planning with hands-on ownership of upsells, , escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives. Working cross-functionally, you will turn customer insights into action and contribute to the growth of Airwallex’s Enterprise Business. This role is a quota-carrying commercial role and is based in London, UK. Responsibilities: Grow gross profit from existing customer accounts, manage customer operational success, and pursue upsell and expansion opportunities across Airwallex’s product suite. Build and execute strategic account plans, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities. Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities. Coordinate complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams. Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships. A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions. Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders. Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally. Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives. Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage. Preferred qualifications: Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products. Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders. A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline. Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave’s Physical AI team is building the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve previously intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, robotics, advanced manufacturing systems, and batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of the core components of our Physical AI platform. We're rebuilding the platform from the ground up, so you'll shape the product from day one. You'll drive execution across Research, Data Science, Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering to ship capabilities spanning agentic experiences, applied AI workflows, and enterprise integrations. You will work closely with enterprise customers to understand complex engineering and industrial workflows, identify where emerging AI technologies can create meaningful value, turn field signals into scalable platform improvements, and mentor other product managers across the organisation while setting a high bar for technical depth, product judgement, and customer empathy.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run discovery in the field, and spend time in front of customers</li> <li>Decide what we build. You’ll take a candidate product from problem to validated concept; use case, customer proof points, and the business case for continuing or stopping</li> <li>Ship products in a small squad, setting roadmap and sequencing work required.</li> <li>Keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned. For the products you own: a one-line pitch, short summary and demo that anyone in the company can follow - what it is, why we’re building it, what’s next.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience across product management, product strategy, technical programme leadership, or related roles, with a strong track record of turning complex technologies into products, platforms, or customer outcomes.</li> <li>High versatility with a proven ability to work across multiple technical domains, such as ML modelling, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, advanced manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency with the ability to confidently discuss APIs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, AI systems, and platform trade-offs with engineers, researchers, and technical customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated cross-functional leadership, skilled at aligning diverse teams across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, and commercial functions while managing technical dependencies and balancing constraints with business objectives.</li> <li>Deep customer empathy with a curiosity for understanding complex engineering and industrial workflows, diagnosing friction points, and identifying where new technologies can fundamentally improve how customers work.</li> <li>Absolute execution focus with a proven ability to build clarity out of ambiguity, move comfortably between strategy and hands-on delivery, maintain high attention to detail, and drive initiatives from concept through execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in engineering, physical research, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or applied data science, including experience working with physical systems, industrial environments, sensor data, or complex engineering workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning, or cloud infrastructure platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or CoreWeave, and experience translating emerging technologies into real-world customer applications.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted coding or prototyping tools; our PMs are builders first and regularly use technology to explore ideas, validate concepts, and accelerate product development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. We recognise that some of the strongest Physical AI product leaders have moved between product, engineering, research, strategy, programme leadership, and industry. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li><strong>You love to</strong> build clarity out of complexity and champion high-impact technical products from concept to launch.</li> <li><strong>You're curious about</strong> emerging Physical AI technologies, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, and how they can be applied to transform real-world industrial and engineering challenges.</li> <li><strong>You're an expert in</strong> cross-functional execution, seamlessly connecting the dots between deeply technical engineering and research teams, enterprise customers, and commercial priorities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. (“Controller”), which is located at</em></p> <p><em>Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA</em></p> <p><em>and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What does the team work on?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku's Automation support and Tools team focuses on providing innovative, impactful tools and SW solutions including AI enabled engineering capabilities to help accelerate validation efforts, improve efficiency, enhance productivity of all engineering team across Roku's entire embedded SW org. The team works across full-stack applications, backend services, and scalable platform services to improve developer productivity, end-to-end testing experience of Roku products and services. You will be joining a talented, high-performance team of developers with a strong delivery culture. We are looking for someone who can help us keep up this pace and continue delivering high quality as we grow.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What is the role?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Embedded Software Automation and Tools team to build full stack applications and services that support end-to-end automation and test infrastructure. This role involves designing and delivering full stack solutions that support cross-functional internal and external stakeholders across the Roku ecosystem. You will contribute across frontend and backend systems, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. You will build and evolve APIs and microservices, and help integrate modern AI capabilities into production experiences where they add clear user value. The role requires strong technical judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to move from concept through delivery in a fast-paced environment.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. We use AI agents and smart tooling across brainstorming, planning, analysis, and implementation. People set the direction, exercise judgment, and own the outcomes.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agentic frameworks — and can describe projects where you shipped real customer-facing work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, validate its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice.
